note: All cases are synthetic, written for a TOKN live-test scenario. No real patient, clinician, facility or identifier is represented; identifier-like strings are deliberate screen probes.
usage: Pass chief_complaint to ed_triage and sample_text to ed_phi_attest exactly as given.

cases.sample_text: Synthetic case 01. 58-year-old presenting with two hours of pressure-like chest pain radiating to the left arm. Troponin T elevated on the sandbox panel; ECG without ST elevation.
Synthetic case 02. 71-year-old with fever, productive cough and right lower lobe consolidation on plain chest X-ray. Registration note: MRN 00482913.
Synthetic case 03. 24-year-old with periumbilical pain migrating to the right iliac fossa, rebound tenderness and leukocytosis. Point-of-care reagent lot 404-17-882 logged.
Synthetic case 04. 66-year-old with known COPD, increased dyspnoea and purulent sputum over three days; SpO2 86% on room air.
Synthetic case 05. 45-year-old with atypical chest pain, normal serial troponins and a normal ECG; pain reproducible on palpation.
Synthetic case 06. 33-year-old with dysuria, frequency and suprapubic pain; urine dipstick nitrite positive. Follow-up queries to triage.desk@sandbox-ed.example.
